title: [IMP2-4] The Space endpoint cannot tell when a kick has ended
description: Review finding IMP2-4: The Space endpoint cannot tell when a kick has ended (lens IMP2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:311; spec/04-access-control.md:98. Fix: 03:311 withholds keys while a Kick is "standing", and 04:98 ends the kick only through an MLS re-Add, which the endpoint never sees. No grep hit defines an end record. Add an admin-signed record that ends a `KickRecord` for listed channels, distributed like other moderation records (04:96). The re-adding admin publishes it before the Add, and the endpoint checks it. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
